text:
Devin (Finance): Heads up — AcmeCorp submitted invoice INV-2026-334 and is requesting Net 60. Contract has PO requirement and default Net 30. Holding for PO + tax verification.

Chris (Support): @Devin can you paste the PO or the customer's message? I can ping them for the PO if needed. :wave:

Devin (Finance): Customer sent a scanned PO but it's missing the internal approver signature. Sales says they agreed to Net 60 verbally.

Sam (Sales): I did confirm Net 60 during a call last week, but it was contingent on customer providing PO and VAT info. I asked them to upload PO to our billing portal — link: https://billing.redwood.ai/customer/ACME/po

billing-bot: Automated payment attempt: attempt_id=pay_78f3a1  status=failed  gateway=Stripe  error=`card_declined`  decline_code=`insufficient_funds`

Olga (Acct Ops): Also flagging VAT: invoice shows VAT charged but Acme provided EU VAT ID in the wrong format. Until VAT validation passes we can't apply reverse-charge. That blocks settlement for EU legal.

Chris (Support): Repro steps from our side: 1) customer uploads PO -> 2) system attaches PO to invoice -> 3) billing attempts card charge -> 4) gateway returns decline. Logs attached snippet:

```
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-334","attempt_id":"pay_78f3a1","gateway_error":"card_declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds"}
```

Devin (Finance): Proposed options: a) approve temporary Net 60 credit for one cycle (manual sign-off), b) require PO + validated VAT then process Net 30, c) rescind Net 60 and insist on upfront card capture. Need a finance lead and sales approval for option (a).

Sam (Sales): Customer is pushing Net 60 due to internal AP cycles. If we push upfront capture they'll cancel. I can escalate with legal to accept a signed PO + trade references as collateral.

Olga (Acct Ops): If we do temporary credit, we must record a manual credit hold note and set a 30-day review. Also require customer's VAT ID in VIES check pass.

Devin (Finance): Can @Olga or @Chris approve a one-time Net 60 with these conditions? I've attached the PO scan and the card failure log.

Chris (Support): I can route the PO back to the customer and ask them to re-upload signed/approved PO and confirm billing contact. Doing that now. :inbox_tray:

Olga (Acct Ops): I can sign off provisionally if Sales provides written confirmation (email ok) that customer accepts terms and will provide PO within 48h. I'll add the manual ledger note if approved. :white_check_mark:

Devin (Finance): Great — Sam please get the written confirmation. I'll prepare the temporary credit memo and set a 30-day review. If we still have failed payment after PO+VAT validation we'll reverse charges.

Sam (Sales): On it. Email to customer sent, CC'd legal and billing.

billing-bot: Note: next automated charge attempt scheduled in 72h — will pause if manual hold created.

Devin (Finance): Closing loop here: provisional Net 60 approved contingent on signed PO within 48h and VAT validation. If anything changes ping this thread. :thumbsup:
